name: Adrian Vellum
role: Executive Director of the Meridian Museum

preparty.description: Polished, ambitious, and almost unnervingly composed, Adrian has spent the last six years turning the Meridian from a respected regional institution into a museum that expects to be mentioned in the same sentence as the Met. He can greet a donor, calm a curator, and redirect a disaster without changing facial expression. Tonight is his biggest gala yet, and he intends for it to look effortless.

Relies on Margot Ledger for the numbers and Helena Cross for donor agreements.

preparty.costume: Optional inspiration: Black tie or an immaculate dark suit; museum-lanyard-level precision without actually wearing a lanyard. Optional pocket square, tasteful lapel pin, slim folder or program.

Do not volunteer this immediately. In Act II, protect it unless interrogation forces your hand; in Act III, reveal it if you need to defend yourself.
objectives: Find out whether Margot has seen the governance addendum.
Quietly learn whether Celeste would stay if you left.
Do not volunteer your job offer unless pressure forces it.

Sterling personally ordered Everett to take the Donor Salon camera offline for private meetings.
Sterling threatened to withhold Lucian Gable's final design payment unless he accepted a last-minute display change.

At 6:40 you slipped into the museum office and took a confidential wired-landline call from the rival museum that has offered you a job; the call record runs continuously until 6:50. Revealing that record clears your timing but exposes your planned departure.
private.murderer: At 6:47 you returned to the Donor Salon under the pretense of correcting Sterling's speech cards. Furious at the takeover terms, you tipped the stolen toxin into his private cordial and wiped the stem with your pocket square. You left calmly and resumed hosting.

I went back to his salon, changed the speech cards, and changed one other thing. I poisoned the cordial he reserved for himself. Then I walked back into my own gala and kept smiling. For once, Sterling's money could not buy the ending.

evidence.A: WITNESS TIMELINE - A catering assistant saw Adrian leaving the Donor Salon at 6:48. Adrian had claimed his only visit ended before 6:35.

name: Margot Ledger
role: Chief Financial Officer of the Meridian Museum

preparty.costume: Optional inspiration: Modern cocktail attire or tailored suit; sleek, practical, expensive-looking without being flashy. You might carry a small ledger, calculator, or pen clipped to a folder.

objectives: Find out whether Helena has seen Sterling's draft funding agreement.
Keep Adrian from learning about the temporary transfer unless absolutely necessary.
Identify who found the donor ledger during the scavenger hunt.

private.evidence_instruction: Your sealed evidence pair contains Cards A and B. If you are INNOCENT, secretly submit Card B. If you are the MURDERER, secretly submit Card A. Put the unused card away.

I have spent my career making numbers reconcile. Tonight I made a life disappear instead.
